metadata.bookend_exempt_reason: Rithika's brief fixes the film as four parts of her own narration under a 4:00 cap, opened by her own part title cards. The outro is never exempt: BOUT is drawn in Manim with her own title and handle, as in October.

The robot stays the AI agent. No instructor portrait, likeness or name; the toolkit's portrait house rule does not apply to this student film.
